title: A Verdict for the Alibi
author: Lior Blackwood
blurb: Rosalind Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
